component.name: Klusters
component.summary: Cluster cutting application for spike sorting

description.p: Klusters is a cluster cutting application that helps neurophysiologists sort action potentials recorded from multiple neurons on groups of electrodes, such as tetrodes or multisite silicon probes.
It is part of Neurosuite together with NeuroScope and NDManager. Please cite Hazan, Zugaro and Buzsáki (2006), J Neurosci Methods 155:207-216.
